name: Replace both direct bindings and release the previous instances
setup: $TC p4template create pipeline/ptables pipeid 22 numtables 2
$TC p4template create extern/root/DirectCounter extid 0x1A000000 numinstances 2 has_exec_method

$TC p4template create extern_inst/ptables/DirectCounter/cnt0 instid 1 tc_numel 16 tbl_bindable constructor param type ptype bit32 0 control_path tc_key index ptype bit32 id 1 param pkts ptype bit64 id 2

$TC p4template create extern_inst/ptables/DirectCounter/cnt1 instid 2 tc_numel 16 tbl_bindable constructor param type ptype bit32 0 control_path tc_key index ptype bit32 id 1 param pkts ptype bit64 id 2
$TC p4template create extern/root/DirectMeter extid 0x1C000000 numinstances 2 has_exec_method

$TC p4template create extern_inst/ptables/DirectMeter/met0 instid 1 tc_numel 16 tbl_bindable constructor param type ptype bit32 0 control_path tc_key index ptype bit32 id 1 param cir ptype bit64 id 2 param cbs ptype bit64 id 3 param pir ptype bit64 id 4 param pbs ptype bit64 id 5

$TC p4template create extern_inst/ptables/DirectMeter/met1 instid 2 tc_numel 16 tbl_bindable constructor param type ptype bit32 0 control_path tc_key index ptype bit32 id 1 param cir ptype bit64 id 2 param cbs ptype bit64 id 3 param pir ptype bit64 id 4 param pbs ptype bit64 id 5
$TC p4template create table/ptables/cb/tname keysz 16 pna_direct_counter DirectCounter/cnt0 pna_direct_meter DirectMeter/met0
cmdUnderTest: sh -c '$TC p4template update table/ptables/cb/tname pna_direct_counter DirectCounter/cnt1 pna_direct_meter DirectMeter/met1 && $TC p4template del extern_inst/ptables/DirectCounter/cnt0 && $TC p4template del extern_inst/ptables/DirectMeter/met0'
